name: Free Time
overview: Scripture teaches that believers must use their free time wisely, recognizing the authority of Christ over all things and the urgency of living with discernment. Ephesians urges Christians to walk carefully and redeem the time because the days are evil, highlighting the importance of purposeful stewardship of every moment. James warns against presumptuous planning, reminding believers that life is uncertain and time is a gift to be used in submission to God's will.
